races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet #5 Get #30 New Customer Offer' Novice Hurdle

runners_data.name: Switch From Diesel
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer with strong recent form, ideally suited to this tactical scenario and proven at the trip on similar going.
runners_data.comment: Smart bumper form, Flat winner; maiden hurdle winner over C&D lto; sets a good standard
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful bumper performer, 3-12 in that sphere, second to Bambino Fever at Leopardstown last year; Flat maiden winner over 1m4f (heavy); aimed high in five starts over hurdles, second in Listed race at this track in December, respectable eighth in Grade 1 company at Leopardstown; easy winner of maiden hurdle over C&D 24 days ago; has class, is ground-versatile and sets a good standard.

runners_data.name: Saporetti
runners_data.note: Inexperienced prominent runner returning from 79-day break, likely to race keenly but may struggle for stamina in a finish.
runners_data.comment: Flat winner in France (1m4f, heavy); reasonable hurdles debut; out of depth here
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner in France over 1m4f on heavy in November; reasonable hurdles debut when beaten 22l into fifth in maiden hurdle at Cork 79 days ago; likely out of depth here at this stage of his career.

runners_data.name: Playtime
runners_data.note: Natural leader but vulnerable form recently, though track specialist James Smith takes the ride for in-form Gordon Elliott stable.
runners_data.comment: L'town maiden hurdle winner; found limits in h'cap company last twice; won't mind soft
runners_data.spotlight: Good winner of a Leopardstown maiden hurdle (2m, soft) in March; okay runs in handicaps last twicel beaten 9.25l into third at Tramore lto; vulnerable to a few here but won't mind soft ground.

runners_data.name: Magico
runners_data.note: Promising hurdling debutant for Willie Mullins with Flat class, though 28 days since maiden win may leave him needing the run.
runners_data.comment: Made a promising start over hurdles at Kilbeggan lto; jumping novicey; obvious contender
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner in Britain (1m-1m3f); made promising start to hurdling career on stable debut after 11 months off when landing 2m1f maiden at Killarney 27 days ago, beating Tyson Fury by 4l; jumping was very novicey and needs to improve; form of that race has a solid look to it and he's a leading contender; wouldn't want much rain based on Flat form.

runners_data.name: The First Turn
runners_data.note: Poor recent form including a pull-up, though 38-day break and trainer change to S Curling might spark improvement.
runners_data.comment: Thurles bumper winner in Oct; not replicated that form in two hurdle starts; big ask
runners_data.spotlight: Thurles bumper winner on debut in October; hasn't threatened to go on from that since in three starts since, twice over hurdles; pulled up in hurdle race at Punchestown 38 days ago; needs plenty more and best watched.

races.paceDynamic: Playtime emerges as the likely pacesetter with his prominent style, potentially joined by Saporetti early on, creating a measured tempo over the 2m½f trip. The small five-runner field means limited early pressure on the leaders, allowing for a sustainable gallop that could quicken significantly from the home turn. Switch From Diesel, Magico and The First Turn all carry hold-up styles, setting up a tactical battle in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed and finishing kick over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Kick Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves genuine but not frantic, allowing hold-up horses to close
scenarios.body: Switch From Diesel and Magico can unleash superior finishing speed in the final furlong, with their class telling over the moderate early pace. The tactical nature suits horses who can quicken off a solid tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Playtime gets an easy lead and kicks clear from two out
scenarios.body: The Gordon Elliott gelding proves hard to peg back despite his recent moderate form, benefiting from weak early pressure and stamina at the trip. Saporetti could emerge as the main danger if staying on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Magico Class Shows
scenarios.trigger: If the Mullins newcomer adapts quickly to the stronger pace of hurdling
scenarios.body: The Flat winner's superior ability translates effectively to obstacles, with Willie Mullins' 28-day gap since his promising debut paying dividends. His hold-up style proves perfect for a slowly-run race that quickens late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Playtime and Saporetti go too slow early, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy, bunched finish where any runner could prevail through luck in running. The First Turn could benefit from his fresh trainer regime despite poor recent form.

watchPoints.text: Playtime could get an uncontested lead if Saporetti doesn't go forward early, making him very hard to catch
Switch From Diesel needs a strong pace to show his finishing kick - watch for early positioning behind the leaders
Magico's jumping under pressure will be crucial given his limited hurdling experience in what could become a tactical affair
The First Turn showed little when pulled up last time and needs to prove his Thurles bumper form wasn't a fluke
Ground conditions favour hold-up horses if the going rides slower than advertised, particularly helping Switch From Diesel

races.name: Ladbrokes 'That's Ladisfaction' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Hashtag Pretender
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 258 days but showed promise in both recent chase starts and gets weight relief from his 3lb claimer
runners_data.comment: H'cap chase debutant, promise in both chase starts, new headgear, can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: 1-9 over hurdles; promise in both chase starts; 8.5l second in Killarney beginners' (2m1f, gd-yld) and when 5l behind Birdie Or Bust in a novice at Listowel (17.5f, gd-yld) last September; worse off at weights with that rival and not seen since but can't discount on handicap chase debut in new headgear combination.

runners_data.name: Birdie Or Bust
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from top stable who disappointed at Fairyhouse but had run well in Grade 3 company here previously
runners_data.comment: Rated 13lb higher over hurdles, poor efforts last twice, on nice mark but revival needed
runners_data.spotlight: 2-11 over fences; rated 13lb higher over hurdles; ran well when second in Grade 3 novice here in October (War Correspondent third); has disappointed at Fairyhouse and when pulled up over C&D since returning from a break; needs to leave those efforts behind.

runners_data.name: War Correspondent
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who runs well in defeat but carries a 7lb claimer and needs the pace to develop strongly
runners_data.comment: Fine third in Grade 3 novice chase here in October, big chance if replicates that form
runners_data.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with but often runs well in defeat; beaten 7.75l off 3lb higher on his last start in this sphere at Wexford on penultimate; 9l fourth in claiming hurdle back there on latest; best chase effort came when a 6l third in a Grade 3 novice here (18.5f, gd-yld) in October (Birdie Or Bust second); big chance on that form and has won here over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Indiana Jones
runners_data.note: Prominent runner back from the doldrums with improved efforts in hot handicaps at Aintree and here recently
runners_data.comment: Back to form the last twice, drops in grade, rider takes off handy 7lb, big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a long spell in the doldrums with improved efforts in hot handicap chases at Aintree (2m5f, gd-sft) and over C&D (yielding) the last twice; big chance now dropped in grade with talented claimer taking off a handy 7lb.

runners_data.name: Listentillitellyea
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who is winless over fences but gets significant weight relief and has excuse for latest poor run
runners_data.comment: 0-9 over fences, good ground not ideal latest, rain a plus but others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over hurdles but is 0-9 over fences; ground given as possible excuse for 45l defeat at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) on return from 295-day break on latest; forecast rain a plus and has run respectably here before but others hold more pressing claims.

runners_data.name: Park That
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse winless over fences but showed promise when second behind subsequent Ayr winner on penultimate start
runners_data.comment: Fine Navan second on penultimate franked, trip too far latest, would prefer softer ground
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-5 over fences but has run well in defeat at times; fine second behind subsequent Ayr premier handicap winner Moudan at Navan on penultimate (2m1f, sft-hvy); 20.5f may have stretched at Kilbeggan latest; drops back in trip now but would ideally prefer softer ground.

runners_data.name: Crescent Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare yet to trouble the judge over fences but showed step forward at Killarney last time
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over fences, step in right direction latest but more needed back in h'cap company
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner is 0-7 over fences and yet to trouble the judge; step in the right direction in a mares' chase at Killarney (2m5f, gd-yld) last time after successive pulled up efforts but more needed down in trip back in handicap company.

runners_data.name: Gaelic Arc
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has been out of sorts recently and carries top weight despite not ideal preparation
runners_data.comment: Both chase wins at Kilbeggan, out of form, fell six days ago, others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: 2-30 over fences, both wins coming at Kilbeggan; is 5lb below his latest win but he's been out of sorts for a while and not an ideal preparation for this when falling at the fifth fence at Kilbeggan just six days ago; fourth in this last year but others make more appeal.

runners_data.name: Stuntman Steve
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who hasn't exploited his lower chase mark but had valid excuse for latest mistake at Tramore
runners_data.comment: Rated 8lb higher over hurdles, excuse when pulled up at Tramore, can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: 2-12 over hurdles and rated 8lb higher in that sphere; hasn't looked like exploiting lower chase mark in recent starts; valid excuse at Tramore latest (mistake at third, pulled up after stirrup broke); capable of better than that and can't discount, especially if the rain misses.

runners_data.name: Be Fierce
runners_data.note: Hold-up course winner over hurdles whose sole fence victory came on heavy ground at Tramore
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles, best form on testing ground, could go well if rain arrives
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner over hurdles on testing ground; 1-6 over fences, the win coming on heavy ground at Tramore; not a bad effort back there on latest (15.5f, good) when a 14.5l fourth of 14 and eased 2lb; could go well if the forecast rain materialises.

races.paceDynamic: Hashtag Pretender and Gaelic Arc will set the early fractions, with Hashtag Pretender likely to take them along at a steady clip given his front-running style and recent consistency. The presence of two confirmed leaders ensures an honest gallop over the 2m trip, preventing any tactical crawl. Indiana Jones, Birdie Or Bust, and Listentillitellyea will track the pace in prominent positions, while the hold-up brigade including War Correspondent, Park That, Crescent Moon, Stuntman Steve, and Be Fierce will need the pace to develop strongly. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed, as the steady early pace will set up a searching finish that exposes the hold-up horses on good-to-yielding ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace allows the prominent runners to stay in touch without over-racing, then pick off the tiring leaders in the final half-mile. This scenario perfectly suits horses that can travel kindly just off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtag Pretender gets an easy lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The front runner gets soft fractions early then finds extra when challenged, using his stamina and recent consistency to hold on. His 258-day break becomes irrelevant if he gets first run on his rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and collapses
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get drawn into a pace battle, allowing the patient hold-up horses to come from off the pace with late runs. War Correspondent's proven stamina and Park That's finishing kick become decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders weaken dramatically turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where no clear pace scenario emerges, creating a scramble where any horse with a fraction of form left can win. The most progressive or freshest runner benefits from the tactical muddle.

watchPoints.text: Hashtag Pretender may not handle the step up in class after 258 days off despite his early promise
War Correspondent and Park That need a strong pace to develop or their hold-up styles will be compromised
Gaelic Arc's recent poor form suggests he may not last home if forced into an early pace battle
Indiana Jones carries top weight despite his improved form and may find this company too hot
Several hold-up horses including Crescent Moon and Stuntman Steve rely on others to set up the race correctly

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Insure Your Acca On Football' Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Da Capo Glory
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tough task against likely honest pace, but brings highest class having been rated 132 over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Promise last three chase starts inc' here, good second at Killarney latest, big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Talented hurdler rated 132 in that sphere; placed in three of four starts over fences, including over C&D (yld-sft) in December when 16.5l third behind Argento Boy; another decent effort when a 9l second behind Butch Cassidy in a Killarney novice four weeks ago; has won here over timber; big chance.

runners_data.name: Vicar Street
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 312 days but has course-winning form and Mullins stable in good order
runners_data.comment: Placed in listed novice h'dle when last seen, dam chase winner, lacks a run, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Turned over at short odds in Galway bumper on debut in August 2024; scored on hurdles debut on next start at Roscommon (20.5f, good) in July 2025; runner up in listed novice at Galway Festival later that month; off since; dam won over fences and market can guide on chase debut after a 312-day absence.

runners_data.name: Quantum Quest
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up in trip suits, with Henry De Bromhead's 9/38 record providing confidence despite recent Aintree disappointment
runners_data.comment: 129 rated hurdler, sharper for latest, dam related to chase winners, could go well
runners_data.spotlight: 2-9 over hurdles and rated 129; shaped well before tiring late on in grade 3 handicap hurdle at Aintree (24.5f, gd-sft) after break on latest; sharper now and makes chase debut with yard in hot form; dam related to chase winners; could go well.

runners_data.name: Kainsbourg
runners_data.note: Prominent style and proven Grade 2 class over hurdles makes him dangerous if handling fences, though 214 days off track
runners_data.comment: 2-10 and rated 130 over hurdles, dam a chase winner, stamina to prove at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: 2-2 in French bumpers; 2-10 and rated 130 over hurdles; fine second in Grade 2 novice hurdle at Chepstow (19.5f, good) in October; tailed off in rated hurdle when last seen at Fairyhouse in November; that was too bad to be true and his dam won over fences so could improve for switch to chasing but stamina to prove for this trip.

runners_data.name: Wendrock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling for form since December 2024 maiden hurdle win and breeding doesn't scream chaser
runners_data.comment: No win over hurdles since Dec' 2024, poor form last season, not bred for chasing
runners_data.spotlight: No joy since Leopardstown maiden hurdle win in December 2024; poor form in that sphere last season and not an obvious candidate for chasing on breeding; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Game On
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who pulled up on chase debut but has shown ability, with recent run suggesting return to form
runners_data.comment: 113 rated hurdler, no impact first two chase starts, capable of better but risky for now
runners_data.spotlight: 1-4 over hurdles and rated 113; pulled up on chase debut at Kilbeggan (20.5f, good) last June when 6-1 (suffered an overreach to left fore heel); beaten 20l on return at Limerick last month when 7-2; capable of better but a bit to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Fillyoureye
runners_data.note: Chase debutant with prominent style and course-winning form, though handicap hurdle efforts have been poor
runners_data.comment: Chase debutant, course winner over hurdles, bred for this game, can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Chase debutant; rated 123 over timber; won maiden hurdle here in February (2m7f, sft-hvy); poor efforts in handicap hurdles the last twice; related to useful chase winners and not discounted for top yard.

runners_data.name: Mister Frostie
runners_data.note: Front-runner with three poor chase efforts including two pulls-ups, hard to fancy despite recent run
runners_data.comment: Point winner, rated 95 after three chase runs (P7P), hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; modest maiden over hurdles rated 103; rated 95 after three poor efforts over fences (pulled up, beaten 52l and pulled up); hard to fancy in this company.

races.paceDynamic: Vicar Street and Mister Frostie will contest the early lead, with Vicar Street the more reliable front-runner returning from a long break but with solid course form. Quantum Quest, Kainsbourg, Game On and Fillyoureye should track prominently behind this duo, creating a solid gallop over the extended trip. The two hold-up horses Da Capo Glory and Wendrock face a significant disadvantage as the pace-setters are likely to establish a controlled rhythm rather than go too fast early. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those who can travel well in the first half of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Vicar Street settles into a steady rhythm and isn't pressured early by Mister Frostie.
scenarios.body: The Mullins runner can dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last, while prominent trackers like Quantum Quest and Kainsbourg get first run at him.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Vicar Street and Mister Frostie engage in a prolonged battle for the lead.
scenarios.body: Both front-runners weaken in the closing stages, allowing the prominent runners with racing room to sweep past up the hill.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the field strings out over the extended distance.
scenarios.body: Da Capo Glory can use his proven class advantage to pick off tired leaders, with Wendrock also benefiting from the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mister Frostie Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Mister Frostie gets an uncontested lead with Vicar Street settling behind horses.
scenarios.body: The front-runner can build an unassailable advantage over fences, with his stamina lasting home despite modest ability.

watchPoints.text: Vicar Street needs monitoring for ring rustiness after 312 days off, any market weakness would be telling
Da Capo Glory and Wendrock both need the pace to be strong early to have any chance from their hold-up styles
Game On's jumping on return from his pulled-up chase debut will indicate whether the Kilbeggan problem has been resolved
Quantum Quest's stamina for this extended trip is unproven, watch for any signs of stopping in the final half-mile
Mister Frostie has pulled up twice in his last five starts, any jumping errors could see him pulled up again

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get More With Racing Bet Builder' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Sammy Smart
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course form but faces inevitable traffic problems with six others wanting same position
runners_data.comment: Two-time course winner; good run at Tramore; jumping mistakes lto; step up in trip a plus
runners_data.spotlight: Both career wins came at this track, including off 5lb lower over fences in December over 2m4f; couple of good placed efforts this year, most notably when beaten 4l into third at Tramore in April (Aclass in second); let down by jumping when well-held over shorter trip at Ballinrobe 12 days ago; could figure back up in trip with 5lb claimer taking over.

runners_data.name: North Of Nashville
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suits expected race shape, 21 days ideal preparation, easy last win suggests more to offer
runners_data.comment: Won Wexford h'cap by 9l lto; can go well again off 8lb higher but not sure to back it up
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time handicap chase winner by wide margins, both coming at Wexford, including last time when scoring by an easy 9l off 8lb lower mark; can go well again but didn't back up a similarly comprehensive win in 2023 so not guaranteed to reproduce that effort.

runners_data.name: Le Grand Vert
runners_data.note: Prominent style creates traffic risk, concerning pulled-up chase run last time, needs to bounce back quickly
runners_data.comment: Won twice over this distance at Ayr on soft, latest in Feb; below form last twice; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time chase winner, twice over this distance at Ayr on soft; pulled up on last chase run at Down Royal and below-par hurdles at Sligo 25 days ago; put two decent runs back-to-back prior to Down Royal effort and chance if bouncing back; enjoys soft ground.

runners_data.name: Aclass
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner heading into congestion, 7-day turnaround questionable for stamina test
runners_data.comment: Tramore beginners chase winner; two good efforts at Tramore last twice; chance up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of Tramore beginners chase (2m5f, soft); bounced back after a couple of underwhelming runs when beaten a neck off 2lb lower mark at Tramore two starts ago; probably did too much too soon at same track lto; one of the more likely contenders; stays this trip.

runners_data.name: Justabitofyours
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but hasn't completed last two starts, trainer 0-from-11 in 14 days
runners_data.comment: Standout run at Limerick last year; downhill since and hasn't completed in last three runs
runners_data.spotlight: Standout form in 14 starts came when beaten 1.75l by Je T'ai Porte at Limerick a year ago; not threatened to rediscover that run since and hasn't completed in last three starts; up in trip.

runners_data.name: Bodhisattva
runners_data.note: Patient style ideal for this shape, strong stayer but winless in three years, trainer struggling
runners_data.comment: Winless in over three years but positive run at Haydock two starts ago; mark sliding
runners_data.spotlight: Strong stayer but winless in over three years and 1-24 over fences; positive run when fourth at Haydock two starts ago but didn't show much over the banks lto; mark continues to slide and shouldn't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Difficult Decision
runners_data.note: Uncontested lead likely but 13-year-old needs everything to fall right, aging legs over 3m+
runners_data.comment: Won off higher marks in the past but no suggestion of late that a revival is imminent
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle and chase winner who has won off higher marks in the past; not shown enough this year in recent months in either sphere to suggest a revival is imminent.

runners_data.name: Noble Talent
runners_data.note: Prominent style but three poor runs this year including two pull-ups, little hope
runners_data.spotlight: Has been struggling for over a year; three runs this year, pulling up twice and being well held over hurdles at Cork; slipping in the weights but little other reasons to recommend him back over fences up in trip in first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Tiffiny's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent hunters chase win but huge step up in class
runners_data.comment: Fair efforts in maiden hurdles, point-to-points and hunter chases; on a fair mark in h'cap
runners_data.spotlight: Couple of fair efforts in maiden hurdles last year, not out of the first three in four point-to-points this year; landed a maiden hunters chase at Cork by 12l and backed up that run when second to Muskerry Rock at Wexford 30 days ago; on a fair mark on handicap chase debut and open to more improvement than most.

runners_data.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners_data.note: Prominent style creates traffic danger, faded tamely last time suggests stamina doubts
runners_data.comment: Lightly-raced course winner over hurdles; okay chase debut lto and bred to enjoy this trip
runners_data.spotlight: One win from seven starts coming at this track in a handicap hurdle (2m4f, good) in October off 87; backed that up when fifth at Thurles before fading tamely at Kilbeggan; okay debut over fences when beaten 10l into sixth at Downpatrick 15 days ago; bred to enjoy this step up in trip and an interesting handicap debutant.

runners_data.name: Secrecies Of Stone
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner heading into trouble, 33 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Put two good runs together last year; below form since but better run lto; needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Won over extended 2m5f at Leopardstown last year off 1lb lower, was set to back that up next time at Fairyhouse when unseating two out; not much to recommend in next three starts but fared a bit better over longer trip at Down Royal 33 days ago when fourth; dropped another 2lb and needs more.

runners_data.name: Reve Inoui
runners_data.note: Prominent style problematic, 55 days off but better over fences than hurdles
runners_data.comment: Shaped well last twice over fences; drop in trip sure to suit; each-way chance
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who was struggling over hurdles when returning from a long absence but has fared much better in two starts in handicap chases, beaten 10l into fourth over 3m2f at Down Royal 55 days ago; drop in trip sure to suit and chance.

runners_data.name: Il Silenzio
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfect for race shape, 305 days off but won impressively last chase start
runners_data.comment: Landed a Roscommon h'cap well on third chase run; absent 305 days; big chance if ready
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for being sent chasing last summer and landed a Roscommon handicap on his third start over fences when last seen 305 days ago, travelling powerfully before beating subsequent winner Hit The Frame by 2.75l; unexposed for an 8yo and big chance off 6lb higher mark if ready to go after absence.

runners_data.name: A Year Older
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with stamina proven, 16-day turnaround after fall but form has worked out well
runners_data.comment: Been in fine form of late; landed h'cap chase 16 days ago; will enjoy this trip; big shout
runners_data.spotlight: Looked very limited until springing a 40-1 surprise at Fairyhouse over hurdles (3m2f, yielding) in January, form which has worked out well; fell four out over fences next time but made no mistake in scoring at Limerick 16 days ago, beating Cullenwaine by 0.75l; 5lb rise fine and he should relish this extra distance.

runners_data.name: Hascoeur Clermont
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits shape, showed improvement in first-time cheekpieces last run
runners_data.comment: Improved on prior poor efforts lto in first-time cp; chance if building on that
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time chase winner, winless since November 2023; had been running poorly but ran better when beaten 10l into fourth at Limerick 16 days ago in first-time cheekpieces having been hampered two out; they're left on now and he's on a nice mark if he can build on that.

runners_data.name: Seventy Eight Team
runners_data.note: Prominent style creates traffic issues, 177 days off and still a maiden
runners_data.comment: Maiden in 18 starts; 5lb out of the handicap here but a couple of fair efforts last year
runners_data.spotlight: A maiden in 18 starts, four over fences, but put in three fair efforts over fences last year, most notably when second to Hit The Frame at Wexford, before being pulled up at this track over hurdles 177 days ago; 5lb out of the handicap off basement mark here but could go well.

runners_data.name: Mistyburn
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with recent hurdles win but 43 days since last run over shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Won h'cap hurdle at Kilbeggan lto; 3lb higher, chance for last year's winning yard
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for switch to handicap company last twice over hurdles, finishing third at Cork before scoring at Kilbeggan (3m, good) 43 days ago, beating Plain Or Battered by 1.25l; races off a 3lb higher chase mark here and a contender for last year's winning yard.

races.paceDynamic: Difficult Decision will lead from the flag with only token early pressure, setting a sustainable gallop over this stamina test. The real danger develops from the 3rd fence out when seven prominent runners (Sammy Smart, Le Grand Vert, Aclass, Pourquoi Poi, Secrecies Of Stone, Reve Inoui, Seventy Eight Team) converge into traffic problems as the pace lifts. With hold-up horses like North Of Nashville, Bodhisattva, and Il Silenzio sweeping late, this race shape strongly favours patient, hold-up performers who can navigate around the prominent pack's inevitable congestion.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates expected traffic problems from 3 out as predicted.

This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure clean runs and avoid the inevitable trouble in running that will affect hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Brother Walfrid and Frankie's Freebie will contest the early lead, with both having confirmed front-running tendencies that should produce an honest gallop from the start. The 18-runner field includes several prominent racers like Angelo Dundee, Backinbusiness and Petit Secret who will track the leaders, creating a solid tempo throughout. With two genuine pace-setters committed to going forward, the race will develop into a strong test of stamina over this 2m3½f trip. This honest pace strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with finishing kicks, as the early leaders are likely to compromise each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Compromise Each Other
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Walfrid and Frankie's Freebie engage in a pace duel from the start.
scenarios.body: The two front-runners will set unsustainable fractions that leave them vulnerable in the closing stages, allowing patient hold-up performers to pick up the pieces. This creates perfect conditions for horses with tactical speed who can finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Walfrid or Frankie's Freebie gets an uncontested lead while the other struggles.
scenarios.body: The surviving pace-setter can control the tempo and prove difficult to peg back, especially if they can dictate moderate fractions. Their front-running style becomes an asset rather than a liability in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates additional pressure on the pace-setters beyond just the two leaders.
scenarios.body: Multiple prominent racers tracking the leaders will increase the overall tempo, ensuring a strongly-run race that suits patient hold-up horses. The combination of field size and multiple pace angles creates ideal conditions for late-running types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters are quickly joined or challenged by prominent racers like Angelo Dundee.
scenarios.body: A multi-horse battle for the lead creates stop-start fractions that can favour horses with tactical pace who can quicken. This scenario reduces the advantage for pure hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.
